theme_rankings.risk: 투기 대비 변동성 낮지만 폭발력도 작음. 환희장에서 underperform.

theme_rankings.tagline: 🥇 시장 방향성 기준 — 비트는 디지털 금, 이더는 인프라

theme_rankings.tagline: 🌐 검증된 L1 — 이더 외 실수요 입증된 체인들

theme_rankings.why_now: 실제 매출 + 토큰 보유자 환원. P/S 가시화로 밸류에이션 재평가 단계.

theme_rankings.tagline: 📈 ETF 승인 후보 + 이더 L2 — 기관 매집 영역

theme_rankings.risk: ETF 미승인 시 단기 조정. L2는 fee market 경쟁 심화.

theme_rankings.tagline: 🤖 크립토 버전 AI 베팅 — 분산 컴퓨팅·에이전트

theme_rankings.risk: 내러티브 의존도 큼. 실수요 검증 아직 미흡. 알트 변동성 폭.

theme_rankings.why_now: 토큰 가격은 하락했지만 매출 폭증 중. AI Capex 사이클의 크립토 노출 직접.

top_news.title: Bolivia Ups Diesel Costs for Big Buyers to Tame Supply Shock
top_news.summary: Bolivia’s government raised diesel prices 84% for larger consumers of the key industrial fuel, following shortages that caused long lines at gas stations.

top_news.title: Guggenheim Rushes to Clarify 77% Earnings Drop After Loan Slides
top_news.summary: A financing entity of Guggenheim Investments moved to explain a steep decline in second-quarter earnings after the disclosure sent its loan price tumbling.

top_news.title: Hydro-Quebec Inks $36 Billion Energy Deal With Newfoundland
top_news.summary: The Canadian province of Newfoundland and Labrador managed to boost the value of a new 50-year electricity supply agreement with Hydro-Quebec, likely ending a long-running dispute.

top_news.title: Test Your ETF Knowledge In Our IQ Test
top_news.summary: Bloomberg's Joel Weber puts Scarlet Fu, James Seyffart, and Todd Sohn, ETF strategist at Baird Strategas, to the test on "Bloomberg ETF IQ" in this week's edition of "IQ Test." (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: EM Currencies Rise on Softer Dollar and Stronger Risk Appetite
top_news.summary: An index tracking developing-world currencies gained Monday as fading bets on a Federal Reserve interest-rate hike next month undercut the dollar and supported risk appetite.

top_news.title: Berkshire-Tracking ETF 'OMAH' Outperforms Company
top_news.summary: Adam Patti, CEO of VistaShares, joins Scarlet Fu and James Seyffart on "ETF IQ." They discuss VistaShares Target 15 Berkshire Select Income ETF (ticker: OMAH). (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: Goldman Sachs to Acquire ETF Provider Neos in $2.3B Deal
top_news.summary: Bloomberg Intelligence's Neil Sipes joins Scarlet Fu and James Seyffart on "ETF IQ." Goldman Sachs will pay as much as $2.25 billion to buy Neos Investments, expanding its asset manager’s reach in the actively managed ETF market. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: Saylor’s Strategy Sells More Stock to Repurchase Preferred
top_news.summary: Michael Saylor continues to run his Bitcoin accumulation flywheel in reverse.

top_news.title: Stocks Slip as Oil and Treasury Yields Rise | Closing Bell
